Debug Module Control

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x40
Size:
0x4
Source:
debug_module.rdl

Description

Controls the overall Debug Module and selected harts. Writes to action bits (haltreq, resumereq, etc.) apply to the new value of hartsel and hasel.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31] haltreq rw 0x0 -
[30] resumereq rw, woset 0x0 -
[29] hartreset rw 0x0 -
[28] ackhavereset rw, woset 0x0 -
[27] _reserved_27 r 0x0 -
[26] hasel rw 0x0 -
[25:16] hartsello rw 0x0 -
[15:6] hartselhi rw 0x0 -
[5:4] _reserved_5_4 r 0x0 -
[3] setresethaltreq rw, woset 0x0 -
[2] clrresethaltreq rw, woset 0x0 -
[1] ndmreset rw 0x0 -
[0] dmactive rw 0x0 -

Field Descriptions

haltreq

Halt request for currently selected harts. Write 0 to clear, 1 to set.

resumereq

Resume request for currently selected harts. Writing 1 causes halted harts to resume and clears their resume ack bit. Ignored if haltreq is set.

hartreset

Optional. Hart reset for currently selected harts. Write 1, then 0 to deassert. Debugger must not change selection while this is 1. If not implemented, reads as 0.

ackhavereset

Writing 1 clears havereset for any selected harts.

_reserved_27

Reserved.

hasel

Selects definition of currently selected harts. 0: single hart by hartsel. 1: hart by hartsel plus those by hart array mask. Tied to 0 if hart array mask not implemented.

hartsello

Low 10 bits of hartsel: DM-specific index of the hart to select.

hartselhi

High 10 bits of hartsel: DM-specific index of the hart to select.

_reserved_5_4

Reserved.

setresethaltreq

Optional (if dmstatus.hasresethaltreq=1). Writing 1 sets halt-on-reset request bit for selected harts (unless clrresethaltreq is also 1).

clrresethaltreq

Optional (if dmstatus.hasresethaltreq=1). Writing 1 clears halt-on-reset request bit for selected harts.

ndmreset

Controls reset signal from DM to system (ndmreset). Write 1, then 0 to deassert.

dmactive

Debug Module active and reset. 0: DM takes reset values (except this bit). 1: DM functions normally.
